summary: First full run (backend + frontend at 375px and 1920px) against live Kalshi data, Sat 2026-10-24. Backend: 22/23 pytest pass (19 existing + 4 added); the 1 failure is a minor validation gap in /api/quote. Frontend: landing hero, 3 how-steps and the 5-city ticker work. Merchant picker switching works. Onboarding works (35 live cities, TEST_Truck created, redirects to /checkout with it selected). Checkout works: chips, formula-correct quote, 'Opens Monday', 'Not listed yet', Miami 'High rain chance' with the toggle disabled, Chicago weekend thin-depth warning (5 contracts at <= $0.10 vs 45 needed) with confirm disabled until 'Try anyway' is checked, simulated hedge, confirmation screen and toast, and the official trigger text. Dashboard works: KPIs, P&L cards, live market card, depth chart, hedge log; Bayfront shows 12 refunded and realized $64.20. Replay works: YES/NO columns, selects, replay button and merchant switch. No horizontal overflow at 375px and no console errors. Found 1 real UX/integration bug and 1 business-logic inconsistency.

minor.issue: booking_value has no validation. booking_value=-5 returns available=true, contracts=-5, price=$1.00. booking_value=0 returns contracts=0. Add a gt=0 constraint (Query(gt=0, le=10000)). POST /api/guarantees already validates correctly (422).
An unknown ticker returns 200 with empty asks/bids instead of 404.

Replay prices markets above the 60% cap that the live product would never sell. Examples: KXRAINWKND-26SEP12-CHI priced at $0.99 (refund $53.50 on a $45 booking) and 26SEP19 at $0.69. Either flag these as 'not offered' or exclude p>0.60 from the replay list so the replay is consistent with the real product rules.

ui_bugs.issue: Resetting only clears `result`. The toggle `on`, `thinOk` and the customer name keep the previous booking's values. Clicking 'Confirm booking' again silently buys a second guarantee and hedge for the previous customer. Reproduced: TEST_Cust2 got 2 guarantees and 2 orders on KXRAIN-26OCT25-CHI. Fix: onReset should also setOn(false), setThinOk(false), setName('').

issues: Long labels are cut off ('Maria's Patio Taqueria · Chicag'). Consider a wider trigger or ellipsis.
Renders up to 100 rows (40 identical seed rows for Maria) with no pagination or collapse, so the page is very long.

action_items: Checkout: reset on/thinOk/name in the 'New booking' handler, to prevent duplicate hedges (HIGH)
Add gt=0 validation for booking_value on GET /api/quote and /api/checkout/options
Replay: handle markets with historical p > 0.60 (exclude them or show 'not offered') so the replay matches the product rules
Optional: return 404 from /api/orderbook/{ticker} for unknown tickers
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses date.today() (container UTC) to choose 'today' and weekend dates. After about 7pm US Central, 'today' moves to the next day for US cities. Consider using the merchant's local timezone.

Replay.jsx Column: `useEffect(() => setTicker(list[0]), [list])` depends on a filtered array that is rebuilt on every parent render. Any re-render of Replay resets the user's selected date. It did not reproduce on window focus, but it is fragile; memoize yes/no with useMemo.
The dashboard calls settle_open_guarantees() on every request, so each distinct active ticker hits Kalshi (60s cache). Fine at this scale, but the background loop already does this.
The test file creates TEST_ merchants with no teardown. Previous runs left 3 'TEST_Chicago Patio' merchants (cleaned up now).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Live Kalshi data: on 2026-10-24, Chicago weekend ask was 0.07 with thin depth (about 5-10 contracts at <= p+0.03); Miami weekend 0.94 and Miami Sun daily 0.93 (high rain); Chicago daily 0.01/0.03 with deep books. A fresh browser context has no localStorage, so it defaults to Maria (the first merchant). Select a TEST merchant via merchant-switcher-select before confirming, to avoid polluting seed data. pytest.ini adds xdist flags, so don't pass -p no:xdist.
